options.title: Aachu The Heart Landlady
options.description: Aachu sits or stands lower-left, extending a tiny open wallet or handwritten rent note toward Zuv. Zuv stands lower-right, sheepishly smiling with one hand over his chest and a small paper heart in the other hand. A subtle heart-shaped cushion or wall nook sits behind them.
options.risk: Wallet can become too literal if oversized.

options.title: Rent Receipt On The Sofa
options.description: Aachu sits on a sofa with a tiny receipt book, Zuv sits beside her pretending to check empty pockets, both amused.
options.risk: The action may read as money, not heart-rent.

options.title: Heart Doorway Tenant
options.description: Aachu stands at a symbolic heart-shaped doorway giving Zuv a playful rent notice as he steps inside.
options.risk: Too surreal and may look less observational.
